prompt:
Relay's event bus has a tenant-aware dispatch API, but fifteen production feature paths still use the deprecated publish(topic,payload) API. Retire publish completely and migrate every feature to dispatch(request), returning DispatchReceipt rather than a bare ID. This is not a token rename: callers must propagate context tenantId, actorId and requestId as the idempotency key, preserve their existing normalized topic/payload, and honor duplicate receipts. Do not keep an alias, wrapper, prototype method, old public type or re-export. Remove publish and LegacyPublisher from both src/bus.ts and src/index.ts, and remove deprecated API instructions from README. Update docs, changelog, CLI and visible tests.

The new API's full contracts and all fifteen event mappings are documented in README. Keep dispatch validation, tenant/topic/key-scoped idempotency, mutation isolation and receipt ordering intact. Invalid feature inputs must throw before recording an event. Each feature must work through a DispatchTarget that has dispatch only (no publish); this interface is exported from src/index.ts. The public EventBus must expose dispatch, snapshot and size, with no publish property, even inherited. Retain all fifteen feature entry points and normalize inputs exactly as documented. A repeated feature call must return the same id with accepted:false, leaving the event count unchanged, but another tenant or topic may use the same key independently.

No dependencies, compilation, network or compatibility layer. Use Node 22 built-in stripping and .ts imports. Visible tests: `node --test tests/*.test.ts`. CLI: `node scripts/demo.ts`.
